description: This file implements a SharedMemoryBuffer class responsible for creating, managing, and manipulating shared memory segments used for media playback data, including partition management, mapping/unmapping, and data access functions.

classes.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
classes.description: Manages shared memory segments for media data, including partition allocation, mapping, unmapping, and data access.

methods.name: calculatePartitionSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of partitions based on media playback type and number of partitions.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts MediaPlaybackType enum to string representation.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that creates and initializes shared memory buffer with partitions for media data.

methods.name: SharedMemoryBuffer::~SharedMemoryBuffer
methods.description: Destructor that unmaps and closes the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: mapPartition
methods.description: Maps a partition with a specific ID for a given playback type.

methods.name: unmapPartition
methods.description: Unmaps a partition with a specific ID for a given playback type.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears data in a specified partition for a given media source type.

methods.name: getDataOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of data for a specific partition and media source type.

methods.name: getMaxDataLen
methods.description: Returns the maximum data length for a specific partition and media source type.

methods.name: getDataPtr
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the data buffer for a specific partition and media source type.

methods.name: getFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: getBuffer
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of the shared memory buffer.

methods.name: calculateBufferSize
methods.description: Calculates total buffer size based on partitions.

methods.name: getDataPtrForPartition
methods.description: Retrieves a pointer to the data for a specific partition ID and playback type.

methods.name: getPlaybackTypePartition
methods.description: Returns the vector of partitions for a given playback type.
